name: chrona
description: Create human character assets and safely reuse published Asset Center GLBs from one Chrona plugin.

interface.longDescription: Use Asset Center Library to search, preview, select, and import published personal GLBs, or use 3D Character Workflow to create, rig, animate, and publish a new human-biped character with Meshy-T2 or Tripo.
capabilities: Search and import personal Asset Center GLBs
Plan game asset sourcing from a story
defaultPrompt: Show me my Asset Center models and help me import one into this game.
Create a human character model from my prompt or reference image.
